description: I'm Fahad, who builds software with AI tools. Our team is taking on "Flame in Freefall": an AI-powered dashboard that explains NASA's microgravity combustion research for Moon and Mars fire safety. I'll handle the build and demo. I'm looking for someone with a physics or combustion background, a data/AI person, a designer for clean charts, and a writer for the submission. Beginners are welcome. Send a request and tell me your role.
